title: Origin-bound bounded navigation on the isolated profile
objective: Establish bounded browser navigation on top of the SG-000021 isolated automation profile, typed provider contract, and origin binding: a typed navigation contract with a server-side page identity lifecycle, SOFT-approved origin-bound transitions, hop-by-hop redirect-chain validation, and download-trigger denial, while keeping DOM actuation, observation, downloads, uploads, personal-profile mode, debugging, scripting, credential access, and network egress absent.

include: typed page identity bound to the isolated automation profile, workspace, current origin, and lifecycle generation
browser.page.open allocating pages in Cotra protected state with a per-workspace bound and no network activity
browser.navigation.preview as local read-only stale-protection material with origin binding, re-resolution, and post-resolution policy
browser.navigation.navigate requiring fresh SOFT approval with digest binding over page identity, expected origin and generation, target origin, pinned address, and redirect chain
stale-state fail-closed for expected origin, expected generation, expected pinned address, unknown pages, foreign profiles, and policy revision drift
redirect-chain validation requiring every hop to share the exact validated origin with scheme-downgrade, loop, and widening denial
download-trigger denial for executable, script, and archive destination paths
deterministic unit and security tests for page lifecycle, origin binding, SSRF denial, redirect denial, actuation denial, replay and drift retention, and separation

retention of all SG-000018 one-shot, expiry, digest, history, SG-000019 STRONG enforcement, SG-000020 trust and revoke, and SG-000021 profile and destination behavior with no change outside navigation policy
exclude: DOM or accessibility-tree observation of any kind
DOM or accessibility-tree actuation of any kind
screenshots and visual or coordinate control
actual page rendering or page loading by a browser engine
stored credential, cookie, or password access
arbitrary DevTools, CDP commands, or browser scripting
network egress beyond local destination validation and DNS resolution
approval delegation to remote or MCP callers

authority_delta.filesystem: A page registry file is created under Cotra protected local state; personal browser data, workspace files, Git state, and unrelated paths gain no new readability or writability.
authority_delta.process: No new process authority. No browser is launched or attached in this grain; navigation transitions page identity and origin in the Cotra registry only.
authority_delta.network: None beyond SG-000021 destination validation and DNS resolution. No fetch, socket, page-load, or tunnel authority is added.
authority_delta.browser: Page lifecycle and origin-bound navigation authorization only. DOM observation, DOM actuation, downloads, uploads, personal-profile access, debugging, scripting, and actual page loading remain absent.
authority_delta.ui_input: None. No input injection or UI automation is added.
authority_delta.secrets: No cookie, credential, or password material enters prompts, records, history, logs, MCP responses, or evidence packets.
authority_delta.approval: Each navigation requires a fresh SOFT approval bound to page identity, expected state, target origin, pinned address, redirect chain, workspace, and policy revision. No persistent reuse or remote delegation is introduced.

invariants: Every page is bound to the isolated automation profile, one workspace, its current origin, and a server-side lifecycle generation
Every navigation binds the exact target origin with DNS re-resolution and post-resolution policy before any state changes
Loopback, link-local, private, and other non-public destinations fail closed unless explicitly trusted by workspace policy
Every redirect hop shares the exact validated origin; scheme downgrade, loops, and widening fail closed
Stale, unknown, foreign-profile, and drifted page identities fail closed
Every navigation requires a fresh SOFT approval with exact digest binding and one-shot consumption
All DOM, download, upload, scripting, debugging, and egress shapes fail closed as denied in this grain
No actuation, personal-profile, debugging, credential, network-egress, reuse, delegation, or elevation authority is introduced

acceptance.claim: Tests prove pages open isolated on the Cotra automation profile with workspace binding, per-workspace bounds, and no personal browser data reachability.
Tests prove navigation binds scheme, host, and port with re-resolution and denies loopback, link-local, and private targets outside explicit trust.
Tests prove redirect chains validate hop by hop with widening, loop, and scheme-downgrade denial.
Tests prove navigation requires fresh SOFT approval with digest binding and that stale origin, generation, pinned address, and double consumption fail closed.
Tests prove DOM observation, DOM actuation, downloads, uploads, scripting, debugging, and personal-profile shapes fail closed as denied capability shapes.
Tests prove the agent cannot satisfy navigation capability through MCP tools, synthetic input, UI automation, coordinate proposals, child processes, or replayed prior approvals.
Tests prove replay, expiry, digest mismatch, revision drift, and double-consumption protections remain enforced for both classes.
Tests prove all P06 approval flows and SG-000018/019/020/021 regressions still pass with digests unchanged outside navigation labeling.
Tests prove personal-profile mode, arbitrary DevTools or CDP, browser scripting, credential stores, and network egress remain unreachable.

Exact-head Windows/Ubuntu Rust, Node, Governance, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, exact-diff security review, manual review of excluded security-sensitive files, and zero unresolved blocking review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.p08_dom: DOM and accessibility-tree observation and actuation remain successor work and must build on page identity and origin binding without weakening approval, one-shot, expiry, or digest binding.
successor_requirements.p08_transfers: Scoped downloads and uploads remain successor work and must build on navigation evidence without silent auto-download behavior.
successor_requirements.p08_exit: COTRA-P08 exits when structured browser operations are proven with SSRF tests, redirect-widening tests, and the personal profile disabled by default, which SG-000021, this grain, and its successors must jointly satisfy.

done_when: Origin-bound bounded navigation with typed page lifecycle is merged with hop-by-hop redirect validation, download-trigger denial, SOFT-approved stale-checked transitions, agent-forgery tests, retained replay and drift enforcement, and no new observation, actuation, download, upload, personal-profile, debugging, scripting, credential, or network-egress authority.
